info.title: MetricGuard API
info.description: Trustworthy AI analytics on IBM Db2: governed metrics, inspectable SQL, verification and audit.

question.title: Question
examples: What was net revenue by month in H1 2026?

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One or two plain-language sentences generated from result values

db2_hash_match.title: Db2 Hash Match
db2_hash_match.description: null when the Db2 registry was not read

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: null for rows written before v1.1.0

key.title: Key
key.description: Stable series id: metric name, or '<metric>:<dimension value>'

suggested_question.title: Suggested Question
suggested_question.description: Re-submit this text as a new question to pick the option

source.title: Source
source.description: 'default' means the question named no period and the registry default was used

sqlstate.title: Sqlstate
sqlstate.description: Db2 SQLSTATE when the error came from Db2

field.title: Field
field.description: A metric name or a dimension name in this plan

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: Mode POST /api/analyze will use: LLM (LangChain + a real model provider) or DEMO_RULE_BASED. null when no planner is available.

model.title: Model
model.description: LLM model id; null for the rule-based demo planner

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Who produced the plan (added in 1.2.0). 'meta' = Meta Model API, 'anthropic' = Anthropic, 'metricguard-rules' = the deterministic demo planner.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: LLM: plan produced by LangChain + a real model provider (see `provider`). DEMO_RULE_BASED: deterministic keyword rules, not an LLM - the UI must disclose this.

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.description: User-facing disclosure text; set for DEMO_RULE_BASED

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Top-N limit; null = no explicit limit

text.title: Text
text.description: Exact SQL text sent to Db2 (parameter markers, not interpolated values)
